description: This file contains an extension for the CritterStatusLabel SwiftUI view, implementing its visual appearance and behavior on macOS, including animations, state-dependent icon rendering, and periodic motion updates.

classes.name: CritterStatusLabel
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing the status label of a critter, including icon rendering and various animated motions based on internal states.

methods.name: isWorkingNow
methods.description: Computed property returning true if the critter is currently working, based on iconState and isWorking.

methods.name: effectiveAnimationsEnabled
methods.description: Computed property indicating whether animations should be enabled, considering animationsEnabled and isSleeping states.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The SwiftUI view body, rendering the critter icon and attention circle, managing gesture-driven and timed state updates.

methods.name: tickTaskID
methods.description: Generates a unique task identifier based on current animation-enabled and ear boost states to restart the update task appropriately.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Updates motion and state based on the current time, triggering animations like blinking, wiggling, and scurrying.

methods.name: iconImage
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon image based on the critter's current states, such as sleeping, paused, or working.

methods.name: resetMotion
methods.description: Resets all animation-related properties to their default states.

methods.name: blink
methods.description: Performs a blinking animation, updating blinkAmount with animation delays.

methods.name: wiggle
methods.description: Performs a wiggle motion with spring animation, then returns to neutral.

methods.name: wiggleLegs
methods.description: Animates the legWiggle property to simulate leg movement, then resets.

methods.name: scurry
methods.description: Animates legWiggle and wiggleOffset to simulate running motion.

methods.name: wiggleEars
methods.description: Animates earWiggle to simulate ear movement.

methods.name: scheduleRandomTimers
methods.description: Sets timers for next blink, wiggle, leg wiggle, and ear wiggle events based on the provided date.

methods.name: gatewayNeedsAttention
methods.description: Determines whether the gateway server needs attention, based on its status and current states.

methods.name: gatewayBadgeColor
methods.description: Returns the color for the gateway badge based on the gateway status.
